code: set.seed(1) n_traits <- 12L n_factors <- 9L traits <- sprintf("trait%d", seq_len(n_traits))  Lambda <- matrix(0, n_traits, n_factors) colnames(Lambda) <- c("size", "block1", "block2",                       "sub1a", "sub1b", "sub2a", "sub2b",                       "subsub1", "subsub2") Lambda[, 1] <- c(0.62, 0.58, 0.55, 0.50, 0.48, 0.52,                  0.60, 0.56, 0.53, 0.49, 0.57, 0.51) Lambda[1:6, 2] <- c(0.55, 0.50, 0.45, 0.48, 0.52, 0.40) Lambda[7:12, 3] <- c(0.50, 0.58, 0.45, 0.55, 0.48, 0.52) Lambda[1:2, 4] <- c(0.55, 0.50)               # sub-block 1a: traits 1-2 Lambda[3:6, 5] <- c(0.50, 0.45, 0.55, 0.40)   # sub-block 1b: traits 3-6 Lambda[7:9, 6] <- c(0.45, 0.50, 0.40)         # sub-block 2a: traits 7-9 Lambda[10:12, 7] <- c(0.55, 0.50, 0.45)       # sub-block 2b: traits 10-12 Lambda[3:4, 8] <- c(0.45, 0.40)               # nested in sub-block 1b Lambda[10:11, 9] <- c(0.45, 0.40)             # nested in sub-block 2b  Psi <- c(0.35, 0.40, 0.30, 0.45, 0.50, 0.35,          0.40, 0.30, 0.45, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45) G <- Lambda %*% t(Lambda) + diag(Psi) E <- diag(c(0.80, 0.90, 0.75, 0.85, 0.95, 0.80,             0.90, 0.75, 0.85, 0.80, 0.90, 0.75)) dimnames(G) <- dimnames(E) <- list(traits, traits) n_gen <- 5L; n_breed <- 120L ped <- data.frame(id = seq_len(n_gen * n_breed),                   sire = NA_integer_, dam = NA_integer_,                   sex = NA_character_) ped$sex[seq_len(n_breed)] <- sample(rep(c("M", "F"), each = n_breed / 2)) for (g in 2:n_gen) {   kids <- ((g - 1) * n_breed + 1):(g * n_breed)   pool <- ped[ped$id < min(kids), ]   ped$sire[kids] <- sample(pool$id[pool$sex == "M"], n_breed, TRUE)   ped$dam[kids]  <- sample(pool$id[pool$sex == "F"], n_breed, TRUE)   ped$sex[kids]  <- sample(c("M", "F"), n_breed, TRUE) } A <- makeA(ped)  n <- nrow(A) X <- cbind(Intercept = 1, sex = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5),            age = round(rnorm(n, 3, 0.5), 2)) B <- rbind(rep(10, n_traits),            seq(-1, 1.5, length.out = n_traits),            seq(-0.4, 0.7, length.out = n_traits)) u <- t(chol(A)) %*% matrix(rnorm(n * n_traits), n) %*% chol(G) e <- matrix(rnorm(n * n_traits), n) %*% chol(E) Y <- X %*% B + u + e colnames(Y) <- traits

code: relative_mse <- function(estimate, truth)   mean((estimate - truth)^2) / mean(truth^2) upper <- function(S) cov2cor(S)[upper.tri(S)]  score <- function(fit) {   G_hat <- draws_mean(fit, "G")   E_hat <- draws_mean(fit, "E")   G_draws <- fit_draws(fit)$G   keep <- which(lower.tri(G), arr.ind = TRUE)   keep <- rbind(keep, cbind(seq_len(n_traits), seq_len(n_traits)))   ess <- apply(keep, 1, function(ij)     posterior::ess_bulk(G_draws[ij[1], ij[2], ]))   c(G = relative_mse(G_hat, G),     E = relative_mse(E_hat, E),     h2 = relative_mse(diag(G_hat) / diag(G_hat + E_hat),                       diag(G) / diag(G + E)),     corrG = relative_mse(upper(G_hat), upper(G)),     min_ess = min(ess),     divergences = sum(fit$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)$num_divergent),     time_s = attr(fit, "elapsed")) } round(t(sapply(fits, score)), 3) #>                        G     E    h2 corrG  min_ess divergences  time_s #> G us, E us         0.038 0.037 0.010 0.069 2679.637           0  21.967 #> G us, E diag       0.029 0.011 0.006 0.052 3872.619           0  14.850 #> G factor, E us     0.043 0.040 0.010 0.072 1790.653           0  35.924 #> G factor, E diag   0.027 0.009 0.005 0.050 2154.065           0  31.207 #> G factor, E shared 0.026 0.019 0.006 0.050 2859.964           0 138.000
